item.title: Fixing "Error: spawn EBADF" in Angular 22.2 ng serve and ng test
item.description:
After updating a project to Angular 22.2.0 you may see ng serve -o fail to open the browser, or ng test start in watch mode and run no tests at all. Both come with the same error: spawn EBADF.

The culprit is a single option in angular.json, and removing it fixes both.
